caption: The drawing features a large six-pointed star, also known as a hexagram, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The outer points of the star are filled with a solid black color with subtle blue accents. Inside the star, a pattern of interlocking, stair-stepped shapes is arranged in concentric layers. These shapes are colored in bright pink, green, blue, light blue, and purple hues, forming a gradient that transitions from the center outward. The pink steps occupy the top, middle, and bottom sections, the green shapes are adjacent to the pink, the blue appears on the lower right side, and the purple is at the far lower right point. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the colorful stepped pattern following the geometric arrangement of the star. The drawing has visible pencil or pen signatures and notes at the bottom of the paper.
title: Block from Bedspread
